name: Hohenauer
beschreibung: The holiday home Hohenauer welcomes guests to a peaceful, sunny side street at Zeller Berg 5 in Kufstein in the Tyrolean lowlands. This spacious self-catering house provides plenty of room for families and travel groups, featuring multiple comfortable bedrooms, a cosy living lounge, a fully equipped modern kitchen, free Wi-Fi, and a sunny terrace with private garden showcasing views of the Kaisergebirge and the historic Kufstein Fortress. Kufstein's picturesque old town, with its riverside cafés, boutiques, and historic taverns along the Inn, is just an easy walk away. Summer delivers lakeside swimming at Lake Hechtsee and hiking into the pristine Kaisertal Nature Reserve. In winter, the ski slopes of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental are only a short drive away.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy holiday house in a peaceful location on Zeller Berg in Kufstein with a fully equipped kitchen and fortress views.
